The Short Story

Who it's for

Anyone with a photo they love — the family, the trip, the night that mattered — sitting flat in a camera roll.

What it's for

Turning that one photo into a living page: its colors deepen, its light travels from day toward night, and it becomes a page you can open and share.

What's the problem?

A photo freezes one second and then just sits there. The colors you remember — the gold of that evening, the glow of that night — fade a little more every time you scroll past.

Can you fix it?

Usually, yes — if a photo has good light and color in it, there's a lot to bring out, and we do it by hand. Not every photo takes the treatment equally well; if yours doesn't come out right, the guarantee below has you covered.

How much does it cost?

$10 donation for 2 photos — $5 a photo. Not happy within a week of delivery? Our fee comes back in full; Stripe keeps its 59¢, and the guarantee below shows the math.

Your Photos, Richer in Color

The pieces on this page weren't made by a machine in seconds — each one was crafted by hand, one photo at a time. That's the offer: send us yours, and we'll do the same for them.

Donate $10 — and we will try to make 2 of your photos into living photos. That's $5 a photo.

Each photo comes back to you two ways: a living page link you can open and share, and a film you can send on WhatsApp.

✦ Our guarantee

Our guarantee: if you're not happy within a week of delivery, we refund our fee in full. The only penny we can't return is Stripe's processing fee — 2.9% + 30 cents, which is 59 cents on a $10 donation — because Stripe keeps it even when we refund you. So a $10 donation comes back as $9.41. 100% transparency: that's their fee, never ours.
